texts.about_this_item: Myau! balanced complete dry food for adult cats, with chicken. Everyday nutrition enriched with all the necessary nutrients: proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals, with an optimal balance of calories and nutrients. Economy class, made in Ukraine by Kormotech.
texts.ingredient_information: Ingredients: cereals and cereal products, meat and animal by-products less than 26% (chicken at least 4%), oils and fats, minerals, yeast. Analytical constituents: crude protein 25%, crude fat 12%, crude fibre 2%, crude ash 7%, calcium 1.3%, phosphorus 1%. Energy value per 100 g: 1479.72 kJ (354 kcal). Additives per kg include vitamins A, D3, E, K3, B1, B2, B6, B12, niacin, folic acid, biotin, taurine 1205 mg, copper, zinc, iron and manganese.
texts.feeding_instructions: Daily amount by adult cat weight: 2 kg 28-34 g, 3 kg 42-51 g, 4 kg 56-68 g, 5 kg 71-85 g, 6 kg 85-102 g, 7 kg 99-119 g. Always provide fresh drinking water.
